natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields improve early adoption. A guarded test is preferable to aggressive discounting, which increased signups but materially harmed retention. Measure qualified activation, time-to-value, conversion, and downstream retention rather than completion alone.
